name: BCPM Data
summary: Chinese pharmaceutical data (BCPMData Open Platform): global drug R&D pipelines, China and US clinical trials, and China drug approval numbers with insurance and essential-drug status.

api_key.description: A BCPMData Open Platform API key (open.bcpmdata.com, after registering). Sent as the raw value of the Authorization header, with no Bearer prefix.

notes: Every data call is a POST with a JSON body, including lookups.

HTTP status is always 200: check the body's code. 10200 success, 10400 bad parameters, 10403 bad or expired key, 10429 too fast, 10500 service error. Results are in data (list and total for list calls).
Default limits per data interface: 1 call per second and 100 calls per calendar day, changeable by contract. Pricing is by quote.
Detail calls take an id (keyid, registration_number or approval_number) found with the matching list call first.
Field values and many filter values are in Chinese (e.g. highest_status_cn '批准上市' for approved).

endpoints.name: Search global drug R&D
endpoints.summary: Drugs in development worldwide by name, target, company, indication or highest stage reached.

search.description: Filters: drug_name, target (e.g. GNRHR), company, indication, highest_status_cn (global stage, e.g. 批准上市 approved, Ⅲ期临床 phase III, 临床前 preclinical), highest_status_china_cn (stage in China).

page.description: Page number, from 1; 10 records per page by default.

endpoints.name: Get a drug's R&D profile
endpoints.summary: Base record of one drug in the global R&D database.

endpoints.name: Get a drug's status by indication
endpoints.summary: Current R&D stage of a drug for each indication.

endpoints.name: Get a drug's global sales
endpoints.summary: Reported global sales of a drug.

endpoints.name: Search China clinical trials
endpoints.summary: Chinese clinical trial registrations by drug, indication, sponsor, institution, phase or design.

search.description: Filters: drug_name, indication, sponsor, clinical_institution, trial_phase (phase I-IV, BE trial, exploratory and others), design_type (parallel, crossover, single-arm, factorial). Phase and design take the Chinese values listed on the docs page.

page.description: Page number, from 1; 10 records per page by default.

endpoints.name: Get a China clinical trial
endpoints.summary: Base record of one Chinese trial registration.

endpoints.name: Search US clinical trials
endpoints.summary: US clinical trials by registration number, phase, status, country, drug, indication, target, sponsor or date ranges.

search.description: Filters: registration_number, phase_json, recruitment_status_json, country_territory_json, publications_results, endpoint_types_json, study_type_json, primary_purpose_json, drug_name_json, indication_json, target_json, intervention_info, manufacturer_json (sponsor), company_json (collaborator); date ranges start_date, end_date, primary_completion_date, first_enrollment_date, first_posted, last_change_date as {min, max}.

notes: The docs give no date format for the {min, max} ranges.

endpoints.name: Search China drug approvals
endpoints.summary: Chinese drug approval numbers (批文) by number, drug name, manufacturer or licence holder.

search.description: Filters: approval_number (国药准字 number), drug_name, company (manufacturer), license_holder.

page.description: Page number, from 1; 10 records per page by default.

endpoints.name: Get a China drug approval
endpoints.summary: Base record of one approval number.

endpoints.name: Get a drug's national insurance status
endpoints.summary: Whether an approved drug is on China's national medical insurance list.
